items.originalTitle: F1's United States GP venue faces roller coaster controversy ahead of race weekend
items.summaryEn: The Circuit of the Americas' new roller coaster experienced two safety shutdowns during its opening weekend, as the venue prepares to host the F1 United States Grand Prix this weekend.
detailZh: F1美国大奖赛举办地在本周末比赛前陷入过山车争议
美洲赛道的新过山车在开园首周末经历两次安全停机
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
如果你本周末前往美洲赛道，想乘坐那座大型过山车，或许要三思，因为该设施开局不顺。
COTALAND，这条赛道上的主题公园，于今年早些时候的九月底向公众开放。但在其开放周末，Circuit Breaker 过山车在公众乘坐期间两次停止运行。周六那天，有 19 人坐在游乐设施上，当时它停在了轨道的垂直部分。
它在这个位置停留了九分钟，然后才被降下来，乘客们才被允许下来。
可怕的是，第二天同样的事情又发生了，但这次持续了两分钟，客人们才得以离开。
据组织者称，没有人因这次意外停机而受伤，也不需要任何医疗处理。事实上，他们表示这是一次例行的安全停机，由游乐设施的某种问题触发。
声明中写道：“周六，Circuit Breaker 在载有 19 名乘客时发生了计划外停机。游乐设施在车辆处于垂直倾斜位置时停止运行，乘客在座位上安全固定了大约九分钟。随后车辆恢复到水平位置，工作人员协助游客离开。没有人员受伤，也无需医疗处理。”
“周日，Circuit Breaker 在乘客乘坐期间再次发生运行停机。在整个延误期间，乘客始终安全固定。游乐车辆在大约两分钟内恢复到正常的水平位置，游客正常离开。没有人员受伤，也无需医疗处理。”
“与现代化过山车和其他大型刺激游乐设施一样，Circuit Breaker 配备了众多传感器和安全系统，持续监测运行状况。如果某项必要条件未满足，系统可能会自动停止游乐设施，而不是让其继续运行。发生这种情况时，乘客会保持安全固定，工作人员则按照既定程序执行必要的检查和验证流程，并在这些检查通过后让游乐设施恢复运行。”
“偶发的运行停机是运营复杂游乐设施的正常现象。我们的目标是高效完成必要的检查，尽量减少给游客带来的不便，让大家尽快回到在 COTALAND 享受美好一天的状态。”
该游乐设施也成为了法律诉讼的对象。据哥伦比亚广播公司奥斯汀分台报道，马修·坎图已提起诉讼，向美洲赛道有限责任公司及该游乐设施制造商索赔超过100万美元。
坎图声称，他和一名同伴在空中约130英尺处悬停了一个多小时，并因此遭受了头部、颈部和背部受伤。这些指控尚未在法庭上得到验证。
detailEn: F1's United States GP venue faces roller coaster controversy ahead of race weekend
The Circuit of the Americas' new roller coaster experienced two safety shutdowns during its opening weekend
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
If you're heading to the Circuit of the Americas this weekend, you may want to think twice if you're looking to ride its big roller coaster after the ride had a difficult start.

COTALAND, the theme park at the circuit, opened to the public at the end of September earlier this year. But on its opening weekend, the Circuit Breaker roller coaster stopped twice while in use by the public. On the Saturday, there were 19 people sat in the attraction when it stopped on a vertical part of the track.
It sat there in that position for nine minutes before it was lowered down and riders were allowed to get off.
Horribly, the same thing happened the next day, but this time for two minutes before guests could exit.

According to the organisers, no one was injured by the unexpected shutdown and no medical treatment was needed. In fact, they say it was a routine safety shutdown, triggered by some sort of issue with the ride.

"On Saturday, Circuit Breaker experienced an unplanned stop while 19 riders were onboard," a statement read. "The ride stopped while the vehicle was in its vertical tilt position, where riders remained safely secured in their seats for approximately nine minutes. The vehicle was then returned to a horizontal position, and ride attendants assisted guests in exiting. No injuries occurred and no medical treatment was required.

"Circuit Breaker experienced another operational stop on Sunday while riders were onboard. Riders remained safely secured throughout the delay. The ride vehicle returned to its normal horizontal position in approximately two minutes, and guests exited normally. No injuries occurred and no medical treatment was required.

"Circuit Breaker, like modern roller coasters and other major thrill rides, has numerous sensors and safety systems that continuously monitor operating conditions. If a required condition is not satisfied, the system may automatically stop the ride rather than allow it to continue. When that happens, riders remain safely secured while attendants follow established procedures, complete the necessary checks and verification cycles, and return the ride to service once those checks are satisfied.

"Occasional operational stops are a normal part of operating sophisticated amusement rides. Our goal is to complete the necessary checks efficiently, minimise the inconvenience to our guests, and get everyone back to enjoying their day at COTALAND."

The ride has also been the subject of legal action. CBS Austin reports that Matthew Cantu has filed a lawsuit seeking more than $1million against Circuit of the Americas, LLC and the ride’s manufacturer.
Cantu alleges that he and a companion were left suspended about 130 feet in the air for more than an hour, and that he suffered head, neck and back injuries. The claims have not been tested in court.

名为Circuit Breaker的过山车在公众乘坐期间两次停机
keyPointsEn: COTALAND, the theme park at the circuit, opened to the public at the end of September this year.

items.originalTitle: F1's arrival in Austin could trigger staggering $1 billion economic boost
items.summaryEn: Austin's tourism chief believes the 2026 United States Grand Prix could generate around $1 billion in economic activity for the area.
detailZh: F1抵达奥斯汀可能带来约10亿美元的可观经济提振
奥斯汀旅游部门负责人认为，2026年美国大奖赛可能带来约10亿美元的经济活动
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利；兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦；马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计与那些让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
奥斯汀即将迎来一个盛大的周末，该市旅游主管表示，随着一级方程式赛车（F1）赛事来到得克萨斯州，美国大奖赛对该地区的价值可能达到约10亿美元。Visit Austin总裁兼首席执行官汤姆·努南对赛车驶上赛道感到兴奋。但乐趣远比那更早开始。
“这些[F1]车队会提前七到九天抵达城里，”努南告诉KXAN。“这相当于在比赛开始之前就已经有一场全市性的大会了。”
他也享受着全球曝光度。“想想F1期间奥斯汀、得克萨斯乃至全世界的所有目光，”他说。“这太不可思议了。这对我们来说也是一个很棒的营销平台。”
据KXAN报道，比赛周末奥斯汀酒店的入住率可能达到95%。对某些商家来说，这场比赛是一年中最大的活动之一。酒店经理乔安娜·麦克里里说：“这实际上是我们经历过的最好的十月。这家酒店自2010年开业以来创下了纪录。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
她继续说道：“一级方程式，仅仅那四天，就约占我们年收入的7%。显然，我们全年365天都营业。”
麦克里里还表示，由于赛历上的不确定性，这场比赛变得更受欢迎。“我认为，今年的比赛受到了这样一个事实的影响：一些全球分站要么被取消，要么变得有些悬而未决，”她说。
特拉维斯县表示，据报道自2012年以来，这场比赛已为得克萨斯州中部带来超过100亿美元的收入，其中包括该县每年超过10亿美元的收入。因此，他们会很高兴得知，美洲赛道将至少举办F1赛事至2034年，去年已同意续约八年。这将使美洲赛道成为美国举办F1赛事时间最长的场地，超过沃特金斯格伦。
detailEn: F1's arrival in Austin could trigger staggering $1 billion economic boost
Austin's tourism chief believes the 2026 United States Grand Prix could generate around $1 billion in economic activity
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Austin is in for a big weekend, and the city's tourism chief says the United States Grand Prix could be worth around $1billion to the area as the Formula 1 circus arrives in Texas. Tom Noonan, president and chief executive of Visit Austin, is excited for the cars to arrive on track. But the fun starts much earlier than that.
“These [F1] teams get in town like seven to nine days in advance,” Noonan told KXAN. “It’s the equivalent of having like a citywide convention in town even before the race even starts.”
He's also enjoying the global exposure. “Think about all the eyeballs in Austin, Texas, around the world during Formula 1,” he said. “It’s incredible. It’s a great marketing platform for us too.”

KXAN reports that Austin hotels could reach 95% occupancy over the race weekend. And for some businesses, the race is one of the biggest events of the year. Hotel manager Joanna McCreary said: “This is the best October we’ve ever actually. This hotel has had on record since we’ve been open since 2010.”
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren
She continued: “Formula 1, just those four days, is about 7% of our annual revenue. And obviously we’re open for 365.”

McCreary also suggested the race has become more popular due to uncertainty across the calendar. “The race, I think, this year was impacted by the fact that some of the global destinations were either cancelled or a little more touch and go,” she said.

Travis County has said the race has reportedly generated more than $10billion for Central Texas since 2012, including more than $1billion a year in the county. So they will be happy with the fact that the Circuit of the Americas will host F1 until at least 2034 after a eight-year extension was agreed last year. That will make COTA the longest-serving F1 venue in the United States, overtaking Watkins Glen.

items.summaryZh: 法拉利为本周在美洲赛道举行的美国大奖赛发布了一款与冠名合作伙伴HP共同设计的特别一次性涂装，在引擎盖和进气口周围的白色背景上采用草图与蓝图风格图案。

media.altZh: 法拉利发布美国大奖赛蓝图风格特别涂装 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Ferrari reveals blueprint-style livery for United States GP
items.summaryEn: Ferrari has unveiled a special one-off livery for this weekend's United States Grand Prix at the Circuit of the Americas, designed with title partner HP and featuring sketches and blueprint-style illustrations against the white background of the engine cover and around the intake.
detailZh: 法拉利发布美国大奖赛蓝图风格涂装
法拉利发布了一款由HP设计的美国大奖赛一次性涂装
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更广范围的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析与比赛反应。
法拉利为本周在美洲赛道举行的美国大奖赛发布了一款特别的一次性涂装。
这款设计由冠名合作伙伴惠普共同打造，在引擎盖的白色背景和进气口周围，呈现了草图与蓝图风格的插图。
法拉利色彩与装饰负责人西尔维娅·卡瓦拉罗表示：“这款涂装致敬了从理念到现实的旅程。每一辆法拉利在驶上赛道之前，都始于创意、草图和工程技术专长。”
“得益于我们与惠普的合作，我们得以在视觉上让这一过程栩栩如生，讲述一个揭示性能背后工艺与创新的故事。”
这些图案采用惠普Latex打印技术复制，概念由法拉利设计工作室开发。法拉利新车概念专家斯特凡诺·卢帕里亚解释说，最难的部分是让这些图案在赛车上呈现得当。
他说：“为奥斯汀站开发这款特别涂装面临诸多挑战，涉及项目的创意与技术两个层面。”
“一方面，我们必须将与法拉利设计工作室共同构思的概念转化为可实际应用的方案，使其适配赛车复杂的表面与空气动力学要求。”
“另一方面，我们与惠普紧密合作，引入此前从未在该特定应用中使用的创新打印技术。我的职责是协调并验证项目的所有技术环节，确保我们的性能目标得以实现，并确保涂装在美国大奖赛的赛车上正确呈现。”
虽然部分车迷担心新设计在赛道上难以辨认，但也有人对改动表示赞赏。一位车迷在红迪网上评论道：“说真的，在我看来这是一个华丽的设计。想象一下合金模型……”
“我知道在时速200英里时你其实看不清它，但就它本身而言，我还挺喜欢的，”另一个人写道，而另一位车迷发帖说：“我挺喜欢这个。好主意，酷概念。”
detailEn: Ferrari reveals blueprint-style livery for United States GP
Ferrari has unveiled a one-off HP-designed livery for the United States Grand Prix
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Ferrari has unveiled a special one-off livery for this weekend's United States Grand Prix at the Circuit of the Americas.
The design, created with title partner HP, features sketches and blueprint-style illustrations against the white background of the engine cover and around the intake.

"The livery celebrates the journey from idea to reality," Ferrari's head of colour and trim Silvia Cavallaro said. "Every Ferrari starts with creativity, sketches and engineering expertise long before the car reaches the track.
"Thanks to our collaboration with HP, we were able to bring that process to life visually and tell a story that reveals the craftsmanship and innovation behind the performance."

The graphics were reproduced using HP Latex printing technology, and the concept was developed with the Ferrari Design Studio. Ferrari's new car concept specialist Stefano Luparia explained that the hardest part was making the artwork work on a racing car.
"There were numerous challenges in developing the special livery for Austin, spanning both the creative and technical aspects of the project," he said.

"On the one hand, we had to transform the concept developed together with Ferrari Design Studio into a solution that could be practically applied, adapting it to the car’s complex surfaces and aerodynamic requirements.

"On the other, we worked closely with HP to introduce innovative printing technologies that had never before been used in this specific application. My role was to coordinate and validate all the technical aspects of the project, ensuring that our performance objectives were met and that the livery was correctly implemented on the cars for the United States Grand Prix."

While some fans worried the new design would be hard to see on track, others praised the changes. "Seriously, it's a gorgeous design in my opinion. Imagine the diecast..." one fan commented on Reddit.
"I know you won’t really be able to see it going at 200 mph, but for what it is, I kinda like it," someone else wrote, while another fan posted: "I quite like this. Nice idea, cool concept."
